title: Third-party vendor lacks DORA Article 30 contractual provisions
control_objective: DORA Article 30 — Key contractual provisions for ICT third-party service providers
observation: The organisation contracts CloudStore B.V. for critical cloud storage supporting payment processing. DORA Article 30(2) mandates that contracts with ICT third-party service providers include provisions on data location, sub-contracting chains, full auditability, and termination rights. Review of the CloudStore contract (signed March 2024) shows that sub-contracting notification rights and termination-for-cause procedures are absent. DORA Article 30(3) additionally requires a minimum 12-month notice period for termination of critical ICT services; the contract specifies only 30 days.
recommendation: Renegotiate the CloudStore B.V. contract to include DORA Article 30(2) mandatory provisions and extend the termination notice period to at least 12 months per Article 30(3). Conduct a full contract review across all critical ICT vendors before the DORA enforcement deadline of 17 January 2025.
